WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length
  FROM film
  WHERE length IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
), overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(length) AS mean_length
  FROM film
  WHERE length IS NOT NULL
), first_cut AS (
  SELECT ra.rating, ra.avg_length
  FROM rating_averages ra
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
  WHERE ra.avg_length > om.mean_length
), first_cut_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS mean_length
  FROM first_cut
), remaining AS (
  SELECT fc.avg_length
  FROM first_cut fc
  CROSS JOIN first_cut_mean fcm
  WHERE fc.avg_length > fcm.mean_length
)
SELECT AVG(r.avg_length) AS mean_remaining_average_length,
       AVG(r.avg_length - om.mean_length) AS avg_above_overall_mean,
       AVG(r.avg_length - fcm.mean_length) AS avg_above_first_cut_mean
FROM remaining r
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
CROSS JOIN first_cut_mean fcm

assumptions.assumption: “Longer than average” means longer than the mean length across all films with a nonmissing length; the second comparison uses the mean of the first-cut ratings’ average lengths.
